title: From Liouville equation to universal quantum control: A study of generating ultra highly squeezed states
summary: We find that the seemingly disparate control approaches for classical and quantum continuous-variable systems can be unified via differential manifolds of the ancillary representations. For classical systems, the ancillary representation is defined by the time-dependent ancillary canonical variables resulting from symplectic transformation over the original canonical variables. Under the Hamilton-Jacobi theory, the ancillary canonical variables act as dynamical invariants to guide the system nonadiabatically through the entire phase space.
